plays.pick: Calgary Flames ML vs Anaheim Ducks

writeup.key_factor: The model has Calgary at 52.2% (fair -109) with home ice, but Pinnacle offers +104. Anaheim's best forward Troy Terry is confirmed on long-term IR, which the market has only partially priced.
